> [!WARNING]
> Still a work in progress: expect graphical, animation and sound bugs.
>
> The game has been tested from saves all through it, but a full playthrough from the very start to the end has not been done yet. **Issue reports are very welcome**, whatever you find.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Convert your game data again for this version.** Some of the fixes are in the converters, so the new VPK alone is not enough.
>
> 1. Update the repository (`git pull`, or download it again) and **build the packer image again**: the old image still has the old converters.
> 2. Run the packer into an empty folder, as the [README](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh2-vita#install) says.
> 3. Install the new VPK and copy the new data over `ux0:data/sh2-vita/`. Do not delete that folder first: your saves and options are in it. If your data was made for 0.2.0 or 0.2.1, the folders `chr`, `demo` and `events` are enough.
>
> With the old data, the animations of #10, the place and colours of notes and memos, and some characters and walls stay as they were. Do not use the new data with an older VPK: it shows stray letters in the texts.

This version is about what the original does in its scenes and rooms and the port did not. Every stage program and stage function of the PC version was compared with the port, and most of the list below comes from that. Thanks to everybody who reports issues.

### Reported by players

- **Room 105:** the dresser of the coin puzzle is there (#11).
- **Pyramid Head's first scene:** the Mannequins move as they should (#10).
- **Fire escape:** James no longer hovers over to the other building (#10).
- **Eddie in the bathroom:** James' flashlight lights the scene (#10), as it does in every other scene in the dark.
- **Wood Side, third floor:** the black wall in the hallway is gone.

### Notes, memos and menus

- Notes and memos are in the middle of the screen, in their own colours, and the names of items are green.
- Questions have the original's blue bar behind the chosen answer, and Yes and No in the game's language.
- The item screen's status panel is the original's.
- Dying fades to black as in the original, without the red screen.

### Light, fog and shadows

- The fog and light of each place change as in the original, in play and in scenes: the start of the town, the meeting with Maria and the dusk after it, the lake, the labyrinth, the burning stairs, the last bosses.
- Characters have shadows in scenes.
- More scenes have their motion blur, and room 312 its soft picture.

### Scenes and rooms

- Moths in Wood Side's room 202, and cut-out moths for the last boss.
- Pyramid Head's scene has the light of James' shots and the closet its camera; the stairwell after the fight has its shot, light and water.
- Characters where the original has them: Laura in the hospital's storeroom, Angela through the Abstract Daddy's fight and on the burning stairs, Mary at the end of the last corridor.
- Cameras of the cube room, the flooded elevator and the park. The cube turns on screen.
- The hospital turns during its scenes, and several scenes have the sounds they lacked.
- The labyrinth's ropes, the tombstone's boards in Born From a Wish, the trap room's noise.
- Walls that were missing: the labyrinth's sixth layer, the last boss' platform, Born From a Wish's town.

### Music and enemies

- **The music changes when an enemy is near** and when James is badly hurt.
- It plays at half volume in the menus.
- Enemies come in under the original's conditions everywhere; the flooded elevator's Lying Figure waits for the water to go.
- The radio's switch and volume, and the dusk, are kept in the save. Older saves still load.

### Known problems

- Fog can be drawn inside places where it belongs outside, such as the hotel's room 312 and the parking lot's first scene.
- The companion Maria's shadow is a little corrupted.
- In scenes James has no shadow under his own flashlight.

If the game freezes, attach `stall.txt` from `ux0:data/sh2-vita/` to the report, with the version shown on the title screen. What is open is listed in [STATUS.md](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh2-vita/blob/main/port/STATUS.md).
